candidate.source_summary: User-provided URL pathname via req.url -> decodeURIComponent -> path.join with base directory -> request.fullPath
candidate.sink_summary: htmlls() function generates HTML directory listing and pipes to HTTP response
candidate.guard_summary: Method restricted to GET only; dot files blocked if nodot enabled; indexing must be enabled; fs.stat validates path exists; no path traversal protection beyond base directory join
candidate.risk_pattern: User-controlled path directly used for directory listing without traversal validation - allows listing any directory under base path
called_function_context: htmlls() - external HTML directory listing module
enclosing_conditions: no index files found or indices list empty
candidate.context_summary: Directory listing triggered when accessing a directory without index files, using user-provided path joined with base directory
unresolved_facts: External htmlls module behavior and security characteristics unknown
